findings.problem: With the hint "to the police or a boss", anzeigen (to report a crime or a person to the police) is also a common right answer, and berichten fits reporting to a boss.
findings.fix: hint: pass on an incident such as an accident or a problem to the police or a boss (not anzeigen or berichten)

back.target: to report (an incident, to the authorities or someone in charge); also to get in touch
back.example: We reported the accident to the police.

note: The informar-inform Spanish card is close, but it isn't the same meaning, so null is right.
